Q: This is the adjuster speaking. This call is being recorded for claim purposes. Do you consent to continue?
A: Yes, I consent.
Q: Please state your current address and the best number to reach you.
A: I'm at a residence in Conroe, Texas. I'll give you my phone number after we finish, if that's all right.
Q: That's fine. Can you walk me through what happened when the collision occurred?
A: I was drivnig on a two-lane road heading toward a stoplight. The other vehicle came over into my lane. We were
moving slowly, maybe fifteen or twenty miles an hour, but we still hit head-on. Both of our front ends were damaged.
Q: Were you wearing a seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was belted in. The airbags did not deploy.
Q: Did you go to the hospital or see a doctor afterward?
A: I was checked out at an urgent care clinic the same day. They said I had strain in my neck and lower back.
Q: Are you still experiencing pain?
A: Yes. My neck is stiff, especially when I turn my head to check traffic. My lower back aches after I sit for a while. I've
been doing some stretches the doctor recommended.
Q: Have you missed any work because of your injuries?
A: I missed two shifts and I've been working lighter duty since then.
Q: Did you have any problems with your neck or back before this accident?
A: No, not that I can recall. I hadn't had any treatment for either one before.
Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the collision?
A: No, I think that covers it. I'll send the urgent care paperwork over when I can.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
</page>

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
